page.overview:
Who is Adrianna Tomaz?

Isis was the wife of the Black Adam, king of Kahndaq, making her the queen.

In an effort to save his mother's life from the Reverse-Flash, Barry Allen unknowingly changes reality, creating a new world in which his friends' lives, Superman included, are drastically different.

She was kidnapped by the Outsider and used to extort Adam into giving up control of his country, which he refused to do. Attempting to kill Adam anyway, the Outsider pushed both of them off a moving train somewhere in Russia.

Regardless of whether Isis perished that night, her brother Osiris believed that she was killed by Atlanteans during their war with the Amazons and held a grudge against the war in Europe because of it.
